ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens: dark burgundy-red and bronze-green leaves with ruffled edges and some pale green leaf pieces, piled loosely in the center-left of the plate, moist with a slight sheen, covering roughly 35% of the plate, about 8 cm tall at the thickest point | 60
ITEM 2 | Thin strips of red bell pepper, bright red with glossy skin, roughly 5-6 cm long and 0.5 cm wide, lying across the greens on the upper-middle area | 12
ITEM 3 | Pale green strips, possibly stem or leaf ribs, crisp-looking and light green, about 4 cm long, scattered among the greens near the top center | 5
ITEM 4 | Round slice of cooked yellow corn, bright golden yellow with a dry, matte-to-slightly-glossy surface and visible kernel texture, about 5 cm in diameter and 2 cm thick, sitting alone on the right side of the plate | 35
ITEM 5 | Small pale yellow kernel fragments and scattered crumbs near the corn slice, about 1 cm across, dry | 2
ITEM 6 | Dark burgundy lettuce leaf, ruffled and slightly wilted, about 6 cm across, lying separately to the upper right of the greens | 8
ITEM 7 | Light dressing or oil sheen: faint glossy wet residue visible on the greens and plate near the salad, no distinct pooled volume | 3
